clips.title: The story
paras: The Lost Fleet lies broken off the Wetlands’ northern coast, along Baradin Bay. The Kul Tiras Third Fleet was destroyed in the Second War by red dragons enslaved by the Dragonmaw clan, and its wrecks are haunted by cursed undead sailors.

On its last voyage in the Second War, the Kul Tiras Third Fleet came under attack from red dragons enslaved by the Dragonmaw clan. Dragonflame engulfed its ships, and the Wave Mistress and the Intrepid crashed onto the shallows and reefs of northern Bluegill Marsh. Almost the entire contingent drowned or burned. First Mate Fitzsimmons was the lone living survivor.
